cards.technique: 8-iteration recursive SDF (spheres + abs-folded cylinders, smin-blended) raymarched with volumetric glow accumulation and screen-space color rotation; camera re-targets on a hash 'curve' clock
mechanics: recursive abs-fold SDF = infinite nested rooms from one 8-line loop — endless dungeon depth for free
curve(t,d) hash clock snaps camera/world to a new random target every d seconds — reusable tension director / scripted camera
volumetric at += exp(-d) = cheap danger-density fog that thickens near geometry — screen-edge damage vignette
screen-space color rotation + abs(col) on hit = psychedelic hit-flash distortion
cards.why: one loop gives infinite procedural architecture, and the curve() scheduler is a drop-in director for hazard timing.

cards.technique: iterated function system whose fold matrix is a time-evolving Jacobian built from 8 drifting seed vectors — space itself deforms every iteration, sawtooth-wrapped for infinite tiling
mechanics: deformation field that visibly rewires the whole space = moving gravity wells that drag the map
sawtooth fold saw(p) = seamless infinite tiled rooms — mirrored-room generator
Jacobian determinant as scalar = local space stretch factor — slow-mo zones or speed pads
8 corner vectors as live state = level 'DNA' you can mutate to spawn world variants
cards.why: a world that bends around moving attractors turns navigation itself into the puzzle.

cards.technique: 7-sector kaleidoscope wedge fold (angle mod + mirror) with hash(floor(iTime)) re-randomized rotation each second, mouse-steered seam offset, plasma backdrop
mechanics: kaleidoscope fold = one 51-degree wedge of authored content becomes the entire arena — cheapest content amplifier in the corpus
hash(floor(iTime)) re-rotation each second = world snaps to a new random orientation on a tick — dodge-the-rotation hazard
mouse.x shifts the wedge seam = aiming rotates every mirrored copy at once (one aim, multi-target hits)
screen-space disruption fields layered over a 2D scene = hit-shake without touching the scene graph
cards.why: mirror-multiply anything you draw; the 1-second world snap is instant tension for near-zero code.

cards.technique: infinite snaking tunnel raymarch (path-offset function + repeat tiling) with electric arc rails pulsing on a sine gate, fluid smin-blob chamber, Fresnel single-bounce mirror water, glow accumulated from moving lights
mechanics: tunnel(p) path-offset = endless procedurally snaking track from a straight tube — escape-run track generator
arcs gated by min(sin(z*0.2+t*3),0) = hazards that exist only half the cycle — timing gates you thread on rhythm
march to water hit, one Fresnel reflect, keep marching = cheap mirror-floor rooms
light += 1/(0.2+d^2) during march = emissive pickups light the scene for free — glowing loot trails
cards.why: a complete wipeout-style escape run: snaking tube, rhythmic arc gates, glowing pickups, mirror water.

cards.technique: FFT-band-driven world: bass band scales spheres, mid band sets kaleidoscope sector count, waveform draws a ring; polar-fold symmetry plus a time-varying pixelation quantizer
mechanics: audio band -> object scale: the beat makes geometry literally breathe — pulse the boss with the bass
beat -> sector count: world symmetry re-quantizes on every hit — complexity pulses with the song
myPixel(uv, 0.01*sin(t)) = resolution that breathes — pixelation as a status effect (drunk/poison screen)
polar coordinates as first-class space (atan/length remap) = radial arenas for free
cards.why: direct music-to-mechanics bindings: the soundtrack IS the difficulty curve.

cards.technique: library of 10 exact 2D tiling SDFs (square, hexagon, triangle, lozenge, rhombus, rectangle, octagon-square, square-triangle, hexa-triangle), each returning distance PLUS tile-type id; demo crossfades hash-randomized tiling configs every second
mechanics: tiling returns (distance, cellTYPE) = instant hex/tri/octagon grid level layout with per-cell type for free
hash-seeded pattern per floor(time) interval = level re-tiles into a new topology every N seconds
seeded hash per tile = deterministic cell contents (chests/traps/keys) from tile id alone — stable replays
smoothstep crossfade between two seeded configs = morphing level transitions
cards.why: a ready-made hex-grid map generator with cell-type ids — a floor plan in 20 lines.

cards.technique: BPM-locked scene machine (animswitch from fract(time*BPM)) toggles 2D-pattern mode vs 3D room; 2D pattern bends ray directions mid-march; lighting quantized to 5 toon bands; mirrored pillars carry per-cell hash rotations
mechanics: animswitch(BPM) = all world states flip on the beat — doors, palettes, physics modes locked to music
rd += pattern2(uv)*0.02 inside the march loop = screen-space warp field that bends your shots — heat haze / gravity zones
floor((light)*5)/5 toon banding = readability-first combat rendering, cheap fog-of-visibility steps
mo() mirror fold + hash per pillar id = symmetric arena where each column rolls its own pose
cards.why: beat-locked state switching is a full rhythm-game harness and the ray-bending field is a new weapon class.

cards.technique: Menger sponge rotated through a 4th dimension (xw/yw/zw plane rotations) sliced by an animated half-space; the cut face gets a glowing comparison grid; whole sequence choreographed on a beat timeline
mechanics: 4D object rendered as a 3D slice: move the slice plane to reveal different 'floors' of a 4D dungeon — Miegakure-style navigation
cross-section grid = a map that only exists on the cut — minimap generated by intersection, not authored
slice offset animated on the beat = the dungeon reconfigures every bar
scripted beat timeline (BTIME constants) = boss phases pre-scheduled to the soundtrack
cards.why: the 4D-slice reveal is a genuine genre mechanic; a map that only exists on the cut is a striking discovery beat.

cards.technique: sums 277 aliased (step-quantized) sine plane-waves into an interference field; mouse scrubs time phase and palette — a parameterized image generator in 10 lines
mechanics: heightfield = sum of quantized sin(dot(u,a_i)+phi_i): terrain/energy field with a single knob n as difficulty
aliased sine floor(x*s) = stepped waves — terraced plateau terrain, retro chunky
mouse scrubs one phase parameter and the whole world morphs — live level-morph slider as a boss weakness
deterministic from (t, params) = replayable generated worlds without storage
cards.why: 10 lines yield an infinite deterministic terrain generator you can scrub in real time.

cards.technique: 6-iteration fold loop: mirror-fold cell abs(2*fract(p-0.5)-1) then rotate by p.y*sin(t) per iteration; glow rendered on the x==0 crossings
mechanics: per-cell rotation varying with time = every room segment spins on its own sine — rotating-corridor puzzle
fold->rotate->fold stack = recursive mirrored corridors from 6 lines
glow on p.x==0 crossings = free 'energy conduit' lines to ride or avoid
cell phase offset by iteration index = wave of rotation propagating through the level
cards.why: rotating rooms whose phase differs per cell = pure navigation skill for nearly zero port cost.

cards.technique: world twisted by its own position (rotations driven by sin of the other axes), expanding pulse shells that thin over time, 10-fold carved fractal interior, plus glitch post: random pixelation bursts and random screen mirror; glow accumulated per march step
mechanics: expanding shockwave ring (radius = pow(fract(t),2)*20) = rhythmic wall-of-death you dodge by depth
position-dependent world twist = a current that drags your flight path — steer against the spin
curve(time,2.0)>0.6 -> uv=abs(uv): random screen mirror = reality glitch event (hit feedback or sanity meter)
10-iteration subtracted-cell carving with per-cell jitter = cave interiors and bonus pockets
curve()-driven pixelation bursts = cheap damage/glitch feedback
cards.why: shockwave + twist-current + glitch bursts = a complete hazard toolkit for an escape runner.

cards.technique: golfed 4D kali-fold fractal: axis-swap fold (q.x<q.y?swap), orbit scale s*=2.3/|q|^2, animated 4th coordinate q.w=sin(t*0.4), Rodrigues rotation per step, volumetric glow accumulation
mechanics: 4th spatial axis animated by time = geometry that exists 'yesterday/tomorrow' — time-travel rooms where w is the time dial
axis-swap fold = non-euclidean mirror rooms (walking east flips you north)
log(s) orbit trap = free 'depth into the maze' meter shown as color
glow accumulation per step = distance-based threat lighting
cards.why: w-as-time is the deepest mechanic in the batch: the same corridor holds different loot at different w.

cards.technique: 2D fbm noise with domain-warp ripple, animated wide-angle lens (ray z-term warped by sin(t)*|xy|^2), fast-flicker lightning bands sin(x*0.1 + t*sin(t*100))
mechanics: animated barrel distortion = pressure/depth zones that warp the whole view — underwater or gravity-well feedback
sin(iTime*100) flicker lines = instant lightning-strike overlay synced to a hazard timer
radial intensity dot(bp*intensity,bp) = energy falloff around a storm eye — approach-at-your-peril telegraph
cards.why: pure post-FX kit: lens breathing + flicker give cheap danger telegraphs with no gameplay rewrite.

cards.technique: tunnel fly-through where each 2-unit wall cell rolls a random shutter panel that spins open/closed on its own clock (hash(floor(z)) phase), obstacles morph sphere<->box with sin(t); 3-bounce reflections and a halftone overlay
mechanics: per-cell shutters on independent clocks = rhythmic gates — learn each cell's phase to slip through
mix(sdSphere, sdBox, sin(t)) = morphing obstacles with a safe window when flat — dodge-timing teaching
grid-stepped ray advance (cell-boundary clipping in the marcher) = cheap broadphase for grid worlds
multi-bounce reflection = rear-view awareness for chases (see pursuers in the walls)
cards.why: shutters plus morphing blocks are two complete dodge mechanics; per-cell phases give skill depth at no art cost.

cards.technique: times-table chords on a circle (connect i -> i*mul) over a generalized Mandelbrot whose lobe count = mul; optional reciprocal mapping folds everything outside the unit circle back inside
mechanics: reciprocal inversion (r -> 1/r^2) past a boundary ring = inside-out world: the horizon is the level's other side
one scalar mul morphs the whole world family — difficulty/biome dial with smooth lobe growth
chord lines i->i*mul = constellation puzzle: nodes and connections generated by pure arithmetic
zoom pulsing with sin(t) = breathing world scale as ambiance or mechanic
cards.why: inversion plus a one-knob world family gives cheap biome variety and a signature world-inside-out moment.
